intent: Compare how the relative supply level and relative salary level change over time across the full observed period.

requirements.question: Are all required line series shown in every declared panel?
How do the relative supply level and relative salary level change over the full observed period, and how do those changes compare?
In the single panel, the relative Salary level falls over the full observed period from 0.95 at point_order 1 to 0.05 at point_order 40.

In the single panel, the relative Supply and Salary levels move in opposite directions over the full observed period: Supply rises from 0.02 to 1.00 while Salary falls from 0.95 to 0.05, so their relative ordering reverses.

units.claim: All 2 required series appear in panel single chart.
accept: every required series is visible and correctly labeled in this panel
reject: series assigned to the wrong panel

units.claim: In the single panel, the relative Supply level rises over the full observed period from 0.02 at point_order 1 to 1.00 at point_order 40.
units.computation: Compare first and last Supply values: 0.02 -> 1.00; monotonic increase across the observed sequence.
accept: Supply increases from 0.02 to 1.00 over the period
Supply trend is upward across the full observed period

units.claim: In the single panel, the relative Salary level falls over the full observed period from 0.95 at point_order 1 to 0.05 at point_order 40.
units.computation: Compare first and last Salary values: 0.95 -> 0.05; monotonic decrease across the observed sequence.
accept: Salary decreases from 0.95 to 0.05 over the period
Salary trend is downward across the full observed period

units.claim: In the single panel, the relative Supply and Salary levels move in opposite directions over the full observed period: Supply rises from 0.02 to 1.00 while Salary falls from 0.95 to 0.05, so their relative ordering reverses.
units.computation: Supply change = +0.98; Salary change = -0.90; at start Salary (0.95) > Supply (0.02), at end Supply (1.00) > Salary (0.05).
accept: Supply rises while Salary falls over the period
The two series diverge and reverse relative order

optional_valid: Mentioning that Supply reaches its maximum of 1.00 at the final point and Salary reaches its minimum of 0.05 near the final points.
unsupported_to_avoid: Causal explanations for why Supply rises or Salary falls
Exact crossing point_order unless directly read from the chart
Claims about panels other than the single panel
Absolute or percentage change values beyond the endpoint comparison
review_notes: The intent asks for relative supply and relative salary changes over the full observed period and their comparison; three semantic units cover the two trends and the cross-series comparison.
No crossing unit is included because the exact crossing point_order is not explicitly supplied in the table summary.
Panel is empty in the supplied structure, so all units apply to the single panel.
